chase-t.label: DC chasing win rate, all seasons
chase-t.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
chase-t.filters: Second innings, matches with a result
chase-t.query: SELECT CASE WHEN i1.runs < 150 THEN 'under 150' WHEN i1.runs < 175 THEN '150–174' WHEN i1.runs < 200 THEN '175–199' ELSE '200+' END band, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN m.winner_id = i2.batting_team_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) won, SUM(CASE WHEN i2.batting_team_id IN (8,11) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) tn, SUM(CASE WHEN i2.batting_team_id IN (8,11) AND m.winner_id = i2.batting_team_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) tw FROM matches m JOIN innings i1 ON i1.match_id = m.match_id AND i1.innings_number = 1 JOIN innings i2 ON i2.match_id = m.match_id AND i2.innings_number = 2 WHERE m.winner_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY band

chase-rr-911.label: IPL win rate when needing 9–11 an over at halfway
chase-rr-911.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
chase-rr-911.query: SELECT CASE WHEN rr_need < 9 THEN 'under 9' WHEN rr_need < 11 THEN '9–11' WHEN rr_need < 13 THEN '11–13' ELSE '13+' END band, COUNT(*) n, SUM(won) won, SUM(is_t) tn, SUM(is_t * won) tw FROM ( SELECT i2.batting_team_id IN (8,11) is_t, CASE WHEN m.winner_id = i2.batting_team_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END won, (i1.runs + 1 - SUM(d.total_runs)) * 6.0 / (120 - SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) rr_need FROM matches m JOIN innings i1 ON i1.match_id = m.match_id AND i1.innings_number = 1 JOIN innings i2 ON i2.match_id = m.match_id AND i2.innings_number = 2 JOIN deliveries d ON d.innings_id = i2.innings_id AND d.over_num < 10 WHERE m.winner_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.match_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 60) GROUP BY band
